newsitem.title: USA: Hollywood Casino completes Pratt spin-off.
newsitem.headline: Hollywood Casino completes Pratt spin-off.

text.p: Hollywood Casino Corp on Tuesday said that it completed the spin-off of its holdings of Pratt Hotel Corp to shareholders.
Pratt Hotel will begin trading on the American Stock Exchange on January 2 under its new name and symbol, Greate Bay Casino Corp, the companies said in separate releases.

Hollywood Casino said Pratt's spin-off should improve its balance sheet because Pratt had a negative book value of more than $100 million. Pratt owns and operates the Sands Hotel and Casino in Atlantic City, N.J.
Hollywood Casino shareholders will receive 0.167852 shares of Greate Bay for each share of Hollywood Casino. About 4.155 million shares of Greate Bay will be distributed, Hollywood Casino said.
Hollywood Casino stock was up 11/16 at 3-13/16 in midafternoon trading on the Nasdaq.
